en.answer: If there are no cards on your opponent's field, you cannot activate the effect of <<12690>> that increases the ATK of a "SPYRAL" monster on your field.
en.question: If there are no cards on my opponent's field, can I Tribute <<12690>> to activate its effect that increases the ATK of a "SPYRAL" monster on my field?
